title: Daily digest: Telangana Deputy Chief Minister, Ministe | Govt. gears up for 'alarming’ situation  | Chief Minister directs officials to make
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Telangana Deputy Chief Minister, Ministers use HMR-TGSRTC common pass to travel by metro rail.
Govt. gears up for 'alarming’ situation in the offing under El Nino impact.
Chief Minister directs officials to make Mysuru flex-free during Dasara.
bullets_ur: Telangana ke Deputy Chief Minister aur ministers ne metro safar ke liye HMR-TGSRTC common pass istemaal kiya.
Hukumat ne El Nino ke asraat ke tehat samne aane wali "khatarnak" sorat-e-haal ke liye tayyari shuru kar di.
Wazir-e-ala ki ahalkaron ko Dasara ke dauran Mysuru ko flex-free karne ki hidayat.
